{{small|(19 September 2026)}}{{cite web |title=Anđelković debitiral z zmago |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/andelkovic-debitiral-z-zmago-421312 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=19 September 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}} | attendance = 59,811 | average attendance = 1,221 | prevseason = [[2025–26 Slovenian PrvaLiga|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Slovenian PrvaLiga|2027–28]] | updated = 20 September 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Slovenian PrvaLiga''' is the 36th season of the [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]], the top flight of [[Football in Slovenia|Slovenian football]]. For sponsorship reasons, the competition is officially known as the Prva liga Telemach. The season began on 17 July 2026 and is scheduled to end on 22 May 2027.{{cite web |title=Nafta 1903 - Koper |url=https://www.nzs.si/klubi/moski/prva-liga-telemach/tekme/nd-lendava-1903-fc-koper-1snl2627-2026-07-17-180000 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=17 July 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Žreb PLT: Celje začenja proti Muri |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/zreb-plt-celje-zacenja-proti-muri-380152 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=19 June 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} Ten clubs contest the league, playing each other four times for a total of 180 fixtures. All league matches are broadcast live in Slovenia by [[Sportklub]] and [[Šport TV (Slovenia)|Šport TV]].{{cite web |title=Prva liga Telemach tudi v novi sezoni na programih Sportklub in Šport TV |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/prva-liga-telemach-tudi-v-novi-sezoni-na-programih-sportklub-sport-tv |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=10 July 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} [[NK Celje|Celje]] entered the season as defending champions after winning their third Slovenian league title in 2025–26.{{cite web |title=Celjani po potrditvi naslova podaljšali serijo zmag |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/celjani-po-potrditvi-naslova-podaljsali-serijo-zmag-379199 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=26 April 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} ==Summary== ===Developments=== The composition of the league changed substantially from the previous season. [[NK Domžale]] ceased operating its senior team in January 2026 and did not complete the 2025–26 campaign.{{cite web |title=Stališče NZS o NK Domžale |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/stalisce-nzs-o-nk-domzale-378664 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=27 January 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} [[NK Brinje Grosuplje|Brinje Grosuplje]] won the [[2025–26 Slovenian Second League]] on the final day and were promoted to the top flight for the first time in club history.{{cite web |title=Lendavčani zapravili vodstvo, drugoligaški naslov Grosupeljčanom |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/lendavcani-zapravili-vodstvo-drugoligaski-naslov-grosupeljcanom-379349 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=23 May 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} [[NK Nafta 1903|Nafta 1903]] returned after one season in the second tier by defeating [[ND Primorje|Primorje]] 1–0 on aggregate in the promotion/relegation play-off.{{cite web |title=Tekme – Kvalifikacije za popolnitev 1. SNL |url=https://www.nzs.si/klubi/moski/kvalifikacije-za-popolnitev-1-snl/tekme |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} Brinje began their first top-flight campaign with a 2–0 away victory against [[NK Radomlje|Radomlje]], with Nal Lan Koren scoring the club's first PrvaLiga goal.{{cite web |title=Prvoligaški debi kronali z zmago |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/prvoligaski-debi-kronali-z-zmago-381494 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=18 July 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} Their first PrvaLiga home match, against Koper on 2 August, finished 1–1 despite Brinje receiving two red cards.{{cite web |title=Grosupeljčani na prvi domači tekmi do točke |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/grosupeljcani-na-prvi-domaci-tekmi-do-tocke-383126 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=2 August 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} Olimpija Ljubljana changed manager after losing their opening two matches. [[Mišo Brečko]] left by mutual consent on 28 July and was replaced the same day by Jugoslav Trenčovski, who had managed Radomlje in the previous season.{{cite web |title=Brečko ni več trener Olimpije |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/brecko-ni-vec-trener-olimpije-382396 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=28 July 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Zmaje bo prebujal Trenčovski |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/zmaje-bo-prebujal-trencovski-382399 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=28 July 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} The first [[Eternal derby (Slovenia)|Eternal derby]] of the season, played at Stožice on 15 August, finished 1–1 and drew 6,000 spectators. On 30 August, newly promoted Brinje defeated defending champions Celje 4–1, handing Celje their first league defeat of the season and recording the largest victory of the campaign to that point.{{cite web |title=Novinci presenetili prvake |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/novinci-presenetili-prvake-414691 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=30 August 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} Celje responded on 2 September by winning their postponed second-round match at Aluminij 2–0.{{cite web |title=Celje v končnici strlo odpor Aluminija |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/celje-v-koncnici-strlo-odpor-aluminija-414996 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=2 September 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} In the eighth round, [[NK Nafta 1903|Nafta 1903]] beat Radomlje 3–1, with [[Amadej Maroša]] scoring twice to move to six league goals.{{cite web |title=Nafta 1903 pred domačimi navijači do zmage nad Radomljami |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/nafta-1903-pred-domacimi-navijaci-do-zmage-nad-radomljami-415118 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=4 September 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} Maribor remained unbeaten and top of the table after a 1–1 draw with Mura, while Koper moved to within one point of the leaders by winning 1–0 away to Celje.{{cite web |title=Mura z igralcem manj do točke v Ljudskem vrtu |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/mura-z-igralcem-manj-do-tocke-v-ljudskem-vrtu-415183 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=6 September 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Koper v Celju do polnega izkupička |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/koper-v-celju-do-polnega-izkupicka-415191 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=6 September 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} In the ninth round, Nafta won 2–1 away to Brinje, with Josip Ivan Zorica scoring his fifth league goal of the season.{{cite web |title=Lendavčani z zmago v Grosupljem na tretje mesto |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/lendavcani-z-zmago-v-grosupljem-na-tretje-mesto-420209 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=11 September 2026 |access-date=14 September 2026 |language=sl}} Olimpija Ljubljana defeated Koper 3–1 in Sežana after Koper's Brown Irabor was sent off in the first half, while Bravo came from behind with two late goals to beat defending champions Celje 2–1.{{cite web |title=Olimpija v Sežani boljša od Kopra |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/olimpija-v-sezani-boljsa-od-kopra-420224 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=12 September 2026 |access-date=14 September 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Bravo s preobratom na kolena spravil državne prvake |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/bravo-s-preobratom-na-kolena-spravil-drzavne-prvake-420225 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=12 September 2026 |access-date=14 September 2026 |language=sl}} Aluminij recorded the season's largest away win by beating Mura 6–1 at Fazanerija, before Maribor completed the round with a 3–0 victory at Radomlje to remain unbeaten and move four points clear at the top of the table.{{cite web |title=Šest golov Aluminija za visoko zmago v Fazaneriji |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/sest-golov-aluminija-za-visoko-zmago-v-fazaneriji-420615 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=13 September 2026 |access-date=14 September 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Maribor s tremi zadetki do zmage v Domžalah |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/maribor-s-tremi-zadetki-do-zmage-v-domzalah-420619 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=13 September 2026 |access-date=14 September 2026 |language=sl}} After the ninth round, Celje replaced [[Vítor Campelos]] with [[Zoran Zeljković]], who left Koper to take charge of the defending champions.{{cite web |title=Vitor Campelos is no longer the head coach of NK Celje |url=https://www.nk-celje.si/en/article/vitor-campelos-is-no-longer-the-head-coach-of-nk-celje-3386 |publisher=[[NK Celje]] |date=14 September 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026}}{{cite web |title=Campelosa na celjski klopi nasledil Zeljković |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/campelosa-na-celjski-klopi-nasledil-zeljkovic-420836 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=15 September 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}} [[Milan Anđelković]] succeeded Zeljković at Koper.{{cite web |title=Anđelković novi trener Kopra |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/andelkovic-novi-trener-kopra-421023 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=16 September 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}} In the tenth round, Koper beat Nafta 2–0, while Maribor drew 2–2 with Aluminij in front of 7,160 spectators, setting a new season-high attendance. Bravo defeated Olimpija Ljubljana 2–1 for a sixth consecutive Ljubljana derby victory, Mura and Celje drew 0–0, and Brinje beat Radomlje 2–1 through a 90th-minute Haris Vučkić winner.{{cite web |title=Bravo še šestič zapored dobil ljubljanski derbi |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/bravo-se-sestic-zapored-dobil-ljubljanski-derbi-421730 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=20 September 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Brez zadetkov v Murski Soboti |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/brez-zadetkov-v-murski-soboti-421315 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=20 September 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Točke ostajajo v Grosupljem |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/tocke-ostajajo-v-grosupljem-421316 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=20 September 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}} During the subsequent international break, bottom-placed Radomlje dismissed [[Ivan Vukomanović]] on 4 October and appointed Bulgarian coach Radostin Aleksandrov the following day.{{cite web |title=Radomlje v boj za obstanek z drugim trenerjem |url=https://siol.net/sportal/nogomet/radomlje-v-boj-za-obstanek-z-drugim-trenerjem-703163 |publisher=[[Siol]] |agency=[[Slovenian Press Agency|STA]] |date=4 October 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}}{{cite web |title=Slabi rezultati odnesli trenerja iz slovenske elite, to je njegov naslednik |url=https://ekipa.svet24.si/sport/nogomet/prva-liga/trener-prva-liga-menjava-1931142 |website=[[Ekipa (Slovenia)|Ekipa]] |date=5 October 2026 |access-date=5 October 2026 |language=sl}} ==Teams== Ten teams participate in the league. The Football Association of Slovenia confirmed the composition of the competition on 18 June 2026.{{cite web |title=IO NZS potrdil sestavo članskih lig za sezono 2026/27 |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/io-nzs-potrdil-sestavo-clanskih-lig-za-sezono-202627-377793 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=18 June 2026 |access-date=7 September 2026 |language=sl}} ===Team changes=== {| class="wikitable" !
